user.title: Set up Irrigation Planner
user.description: Basic settings. At most {max_open_valves} valve per water supply is open at any time.

data_description.weather_entity: Optional. A weather entity used for rain and frost forecasts.
data_description.window_start: Earliest start of a watering run.
data_description.window_end: The watering run must be finished by this time.

error.window_empty: Start and end of the watering window must not be equal.

run_zone.name: Water zone
run_zone.description: Queues a zone for the given duration. Only one valve per water supply is open at a time; a start during a run waits in the queue.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Watering time in seconds. Limited to the zone's maximum duration.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Empties all queues and closes all valves.

run_program.name: Start program
run_program.description: Queues all zones of a program now.

skip_next.name: Skip next run
skip_next.description: Skips the next scheduled start of a program once.
